judged_text: The credential lookup filters on appId, which is NULL on credentials created before the appId column existed or via any create path that doesn't set it, so those rows are invisible to the webhook. For a user who already connected the app through Cal.com's own OAuth flow, the webhook takes the create branch and inserts a second credential of the same type; type-based credential resolution then sees the same account twice and booking flows create duplicate events and duplicate availability lookups.
